svg.aria-label: Animation: five folds each hold out a different fifth of the samples; the pooled held-out predictions are what Q-squared is computed from.
svg.title: Out-of-fold cross-validation and Q-squared
svg.desc: Animation: five folds each hold out a different fifth of the samples; the pooled held-out predictions are what Q-squared is computed from.
svg.text: Each sample is predicted only by a model that never saw it.
Scaling is fitted inside each fold, never on the full set — that is what
keeps Q² from flattering the model. Samples passed to --leave-out sit
